title: Supply Chain Data Analyst
description:
Advanced Solution Development Data Scientist/Senior Data Engineer (Data+AI / Databricks / SQL) - Closed-Loop Design & Pre-Sales Automation
KPI Solutions is a leading supply chain and warehouse automation integrator helping companies transform distribution operations through intelligent software, robotics, automation, and data-driven solutions.
With expertise spanning WMS, automation, robotics, controls, and systems integration, KPI partners with customers to design and implement scalable solutions that improve throughput, efficiency, and operational performance across distribution and fulfillment environments.
As KPI continues to expand its Advanced Solutions Development organization, we are investing heavily in next-generation technologies that combine automation, analytics, and AI to shape the future of intralogistics and warehouse operations.
About the Role
We are seeking a highly motivated and hands-on Data Scientist / Senior Data Engineer to help build and scale KPI’s Closed-Loop Design Program - an initiative focused on accelerating pre-sales engineering, improving automation design accuracy, and leveraging AI-driven insights across the customer solution lifecycle.
This role sits at the intersection of:

• Data Engineering

• Applied AI & Analytics

• Supply Chain Automation

• Solution Design

You will work closely with solution architects, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to transform RFPs, customer requirements, and historical project data into intelligent, repeatable outputs that drive faster and more accurate proposal development.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building systems from the ground up, solving complex operational problems, and influencing how advanced automation solutions are designed and delivered.
What You’ll Deliver: High-Impact Use Cases

•
RFP & Specification Intelligence
Extract requirements, generate compliance matrices, and identify clarifying questions automatically.

•
Cost & ROI Scenario Modeling
Support data-driven decision-making through option comparisons and sensitivity analysis.

•
Proposal “Fact Pack” Automation
Create scalable executive summaries and SOW-ready proposal content from governed datasets.

•
Design & Operational Analytics
Analyze throughput, staffing models, slotting strategies, and replenishment impacts.

•
Benchmark-Driven Solution Guidance
Leverage historical project data and comparable implementations to guide future designs.

What You’ll Do

• Build and maintain curated datasets using Databricks (Delta tables, jobs, SQL Warehouses) and SQL-based governed reporting tables.

• Ingest and manage full pursuit lifecycle artifacts including RFPs, specifications, drawings, and addenda with proper metadata and version control.

• Develop applied analytics solutions including:

• Forecasting

• Scenario modeling

• Optimization (LP/MILP or practical heuristics)

• Similarity modeling and benchmarking

• Publish reliable datasets and insights for Tableau Cloud consumption with consistent business definitions.

• Establish a closed-loop learning cycle by comparing design assumptions against operational outcomes to continuously improve benchmarks and estimate accuracy.

• Partner cross-functionally with engineering, analytics, and solution design teams to improve automation decision-making at scale.

What Success Looks Like
In this role, you will help KPI:

• Accelerate proposal development with intelligent, governed “first draft” solution packs

• Improve confidence and accuracy in complex automation pursuits

• Build scalable benchmarking capabilities that improve operational estimates over time

• Create data products that directly influence automation strategy and customer outcomes

Requirements
Required Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience in:

• Data Science

• Analytics Engineering

• Applied Machine Learning
with proven production delivery experience.

• Strong SQL skills including:

• Data modeling

• Query optimization

• Governance

title: Engineering Lead
description:
Engineering Lead
Large, Complex Federal Government Program | Full-Time W-2 | Fully Remote (U.S.)
The Problem We're Hiring You to Solve
Monthly production releases. Zero escaped critical defects. Most engineering organizations treat those as a tradeoff. On this program they are both commitments, measured every release, in front of the customer.
We are hiring the engineering leader who builds an organization that delivers both at once: multiple cross-functional development teams modernizing a federal home loan benefit platform while sustaining the 20-year-old system it replaces. If you believe speed and quality are the same discipline practiced well, and you have the delivery record to prove it, keep reading.
The Opportunity
Most engineering leadership roles ask you to protect a delivery machine someone else built. This one asks you to build the machine.
The program spans multiple development teams working in parallel across a modern platform (Salesforce-centered, configuration-first, supplemented by serverless capabilities in a government cloud) and a legacy suite that must stay stable until it is decommissioned. Work arrives through a formal intake process that turns business needs into executable plans with committed scope, timelines, and team sizing in days. Then your organization delivers against those commitments, publicly and measurably.
The quality bar is unusually explicit. Every release ships with 100% automated test coverage for its features before user acceptance testing begins. Defect detection before UAT must exceed 95%. Escaped critical defects must be zero. Critical production bugs get fixed in three days. Accessibility and security compliance are release gates, not aspirations. These are not stretch goals on a slide. They are how the program measures the engineering organization every month.
That bar is exactly why this role is interesting. Hitting it once takes heroics. Hitting it every month takes an engineering system: disciplined definition of done, test automation as a first-class craft, engineers who own quality instead of throwing code over a wall, and a leader who builds all of that into how teams work rather than inspecting it in afterward. That leader is you.
You will work alongside a Senior DevSecOps & Platform Engineering Lead who owns the delivery pipeline and an Enterprise Solution Architect who owns the designs. You own the organization that turns those designs into shipped, tested, production software.
What You'll Own

• The engineering organization. Lead multiple cross-functional development teams across modern and legacy platforms, flexing team size and composition as workflows through intake. Teams form, deliver, and re-form around the work. You make that fluid instead of chaotic.

• Delivery you put your name on. Commit to scope, level of effort, and timelines in executable plans, then hit them. When you cannot, say so early, with a recovery plan, before the customer discovers it.

• A quality system, not a QA gate. Engineer quality into how teams work: definition of done that includes full automated testing, code review that catches problems, and metrics that surface risk early. The outcomes that prove it: zero escaped critical defects, defect detection above 95% before UAT, and critical fixes inside three days.

• Test automation as a craft. Build the discipline where every feature ships with complete positive and negative automated coverage, and the regression suite becomes the safety net the customer trusts enough to focus UAT on new functionality only.

• The monthly release drumbeat. Production value ships every 30 days or faster, release after release, without burning the team down to do it.

• Dual-stack engineering. Run modern configuration-first platform development and legacy sustainment side by side, including the warranty on everything your teams release.

• Engineering standards that outlast you. Set and enforce the bar for code quality, review, documentation, and definition of

title: Lead AV Engineer
description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff - payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR - so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

 
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) - because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

 
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role

Gusto is looking for an AV Engineer to be the design authority for audiovisual technology across our entire physical footprint - and the technical director behind every event we put on. This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership: you'll author the AV standard that every site and every integrator builds against, own the multi-site capital roadmap, and design and direct the productions our executives and customers see. You'll also serve as technical lead on our company-wide migration from Zoom to Google Meet, resetting a fleet of 200+ conference rooms in the process. If you've spent your career executing someone else's drawings and are ready to own the drawing, this is that role.

About the Team

As a member of the AV Engineering team, you'll sit within AIT Operations alongside the AIT Geeks, Inventory, Corporate Identity Engineering, Product AIT and Collaboration Tools. We're a small, high-trust team that owns the technology Gusties touch every day, and we're AI-forward - with a governed platform that gives engineers tools like Claude and Claude Code to automate the repetitive parts of the job. AV is the most visible surface we own: when a room works or an all-hands delivers, people notice. You'll be the senior-most AV technical voice in the company and the SME for our AV platforms, partnering closely with Workplace, Networking, Client Platform Engineering, Brand, and Executive Operations.

Here's what you'll do day-to-day

• Own AV design and programming - design, testing, troubleshooting, implementation of AV technology in Gusto's offices, meeting spaces, and all hands event spaces across San Francisco, Denver, New York, Burlingame, and Scottsdale, with new sites in planning. Integrators move to install, labor, and specialist overflow rather than design lead.

• Author and maintain the Gusto AV standard - room tiers, signal flow, control systems, camera and lighting standards, and the event production baseline that every site and vendor builds against.

• Architect and own the technology and production for all of Gusto's high-profile events - company-wide meetings (remote and in person), our flagship multi-day customer event, fireside chats, onsites, and podcast productions. You set the production design, spec and build the technical package, direct the show, and own the failure modes.

• Own the multi-site AV capital roadmap and vendor relationships , including vendor and project management of office buildouts and upgrades, negotiating investment and tradeoffs across sites and holding integrators and manufacturers accountable to design intent.

• Administer our AV SaaS offerings - Google Meet and Zoom room fleets, Logitech and Neat endpoints, and streaming and event platforms - including room health monitoring, dashboards, and firmware lifecycle.

title: Claim Consultant - Medical Professional Liability
description:
The Claim Consultant provides complete claim loss services for policyholders. This role will investigate, evaluate and dispose of MPL and General Liability claims with varying degrees of complexity and severity. The Claim Consultant works independently to provide claim-loss service for Coverys policyholders. This role will investigate and adjust claims with high levels of complexity and severity.
Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• Interviews insureds, claimants, witnesses and other appropriate parties to obtain information used to assess liability exposure.

• Documents related files regarding results of investigation and negotiations.

• Prepares reports to file on established diary dates and other specific reports as needed to ensure timely file documentation and plan of action.

• Secures records for investigation and evaluation of cases.

• Determines and implements negotiation strategy and negotiates settlements within authority level.

• Timely adjusts reserves within level of authority and makes reserve recommendations to Manager/Director for amounts over position authority level.

• Advises Claim Director and/or S.V.P. of Claims on claims status and attends Reserve & Settlement Committee Meetings as necessary. Ensures timely reporting to the Reserve and Settlement Committee.

• Interacts with other departments as necessary to help facilitate and coordinate services to our insured and client.

• Evaluates cases for appropriate disposition and seeks authority for settlement from Manager/Director when settlement amount requests exceeds authority.

• Directs and monitors activities of defense counsel in compliance with Case Management Guidelines.

title: Researcher, World Models
description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.
The Role
We are hiring a Researcher to advance the world models at the core of Asimov's ability to perceive, predict, and act. You will work at the intersection of self-supervised representation learning, predictive architectures, and embodied control, in close collaboration with our platform, firmware, and hardware teams.
What You'll Do

• Design, train, and rigorously evaluate world models that let Asimov predict the consequences of actions across visual, proprioceptive, and force/torque modalities.

• Advance our self-supervised learning stack for visual and sensor representations, building on and extending the JEPA family (V-JEPA, I-JEPA, and related predictive-embedding approaches).

• Prototype and benchmark generative and predictive architectures (diffusion, DiT, flow matching, VAEs) against JEPA-style objectives for embodied prediction and planning.

• Own the data pipeline for your experiments end to end: curation, tooling, and scaling, without depending on a separate data-engineering team to move.

• Integrate what you build with our platform, firmware, and software teams so research reaches the robot, not just the paper.

• Contribute to sim-to-real transfer, inverse dynamics, and multi-modal sensor fusion, and publish or open-source work where it strengthens the field and the team.

What We Look For

• Proven modeling track record: you have trained models and can show solid, honest evaluations, not just training curves.

• JEPA fluency: you understand the joint-embedding predictive approach and can reason about where it fits versus alternatives.

• Breadth across approaches: familiarity with prior and adjacent work, including VLA (vision-language-action) models, and a view on their trade-offs.

• Depth in a modality: strong depth in at least one sensory domain (vision, audio, natural language, or similar).

• Strong data abilities: you get things done without depending on a whole data-engineering team.

• Solid engineering: you can implement, integrate, and ship what you build alongside platform, firmware, and software teams.

• Conversant, ideally deep, in several of: SSL for visual and sensor representations; world models (JEPA, V-JEPA, I-JEPA, LeJEPA, MJEPA); generative and predictive architectures (diffusion, DiT, flow matching, VAEs); robotics ML (VLA, inverse dynamics, sim-to-real, optical flow); sensor fusion (vision, proprioception, force/torque, multi-modal encoders); PyTorch, JAX, and distributed training.

Nice to Have

• Publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CoRL, or RSS (or arXiv work with comparable citations).

• PhD or equivalent research experience in ML, robotics, or computer vision. Not required with a strong portfolio.

• Demonstrated hardware or robotics interest or hands-on experience.

• Strong communication: technical blogs, talks, or clear written research.

Why Join Menlo

World models are the bet that lets a humanoid generalize instead of memorize. This is a rare seat where your research runs on real hardware in short cycles, your data and modeling choices are yours to own, and your work ships in the open. If you want the distance between an idea and a walking robot to be measured in weeks, this is the room.
A Note on AI

title: Grant Manager
description:
ACCEL Schools is seeking a hands-on Grant Manager to own the full lifecycle of federal, state, and local grants supporting four West Virginia schools. This position will be responsible for grant administration from pre-award planning and application support through award setup, budgeting, accounting, compliance, reporting, reimbursement, monitoring, and closeout. The role requires a strong understanding of how grant requirements connect to the general ledger and how grant activity affects revenue, expenses, payroll, reimbursements, and month-end accounting.
This is a working-manager position. The Grant Manager will initially perform detailed day-to-day grant and financial management activities for the West Virginia portfolio. As ACCEL Schools grows, the portfolio is expected to expand to additional schools and states. The Grant Manager will help establish scalable, standardized processes that can support a growing multi-state grant portfolio.
Eligibility: Open to residents of West Virginia
Key Responsibilities

• Own the full grant lifecycle for federal, state, and local grants, including grant identification and pre-award support, application coordination, award review and setup, budgeting, post-award administration, financial management, compliance, reporting, reimbursement, monitoring, and closeout.

• Manage the grant portfolio for four West Virginia schools, with responsibility expected to expand to additional schools and states as the organization grows.

• Review grant award documents, terms, conditions, approved budgets, funding restrictions, reporting requirements, and deadlines; translate requirements into practical accounting and operational processes.

• Maintain detailed grant ledgers and spending trackers, record actual expenses and revenue, update forecasts monthly, and monitor remaining balances against award budgets, performance periods, and spending timelines.

• Reconcile grant revenue and expenses to the general ledger and cross-check activity across accounting, payroll, procurement, reimbursement, state and federal reporting systems, and internal grant schedules.

• Prepare and post journal entries related to grant revenue, payroll, wages, expenses, allocations, reimbursements, and other allowable costs, ensuring grant activity is accurately reflected in the general ledger.

• Review grant-funded expenditures for allowability, allocability, reasonableness, proper documentation, and compliance with applicable federal, state, and grant-specific requirements.

• Prepare, submit, and monitor invoices, cash requests, reimbursement requests, drawdowns, and other funding requests, including supporting documentation required by funding agencies.

• Prepare and/or oversee timely and accurate financial and programmatic grant reports across required state, federal, and internal systems.

• Manage West Virginia-specific reporting and compliance requirements, including detailed documentation for programs such as CSP grants, and respond to rejected, questioned, or returned submissions.

• Monitor grant activity throughout the grant period, identify budget variances, underspending, overspending, compliance risks, and missed funding opportunities, and recommend corrective actions.

• Coordinate grant budget amendments and revisions when spending plans or program needs change, ensuring required approvals are obtained before changes are implemented.

• Support grant applications and renewals by gathering financial information, developing or reviewing grant budgets, and coordinating required documentation with school and corporate stakeholders.

• Maintain complete, organized, and audit-ready grant files, including award documents, budgets, invoices, payroll support, reimbursement documentation, reports, correspondence, and closeout records.

• Support federal, state, and other compliance audits and monitoring reviews; coordinate responses to information requests and ensure findings or recommendations are addressed timely.

title: Medical Administrative & Surgical Patient Coordinator | Colombia
description:
About Us
HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities supporting U.S. and Canadian companies. We focus on long-term placements where experienced professionals can take real ownership, become trusted members of the team, and make a measurable impact from anywhere.
About the Role
As a Medical Administrative & Surgical Patient Coordinator, you will own the administrative coordination that happens after a patient begins moving through the surgical process. You will make sure required clearances, testing, records, appointments, documentation, and pre-operative steps are completed so patients stay on track for surgery.
This is an operations-focused healthcare role, not a sales position and not a remote clinical position. You will work directly with patients, medical offices, imaging centers, laboratories, hospitals, and other healthcare providers while knowing when a question or concern needs to be escalated to clinical staff. You will receive training on the practice's specific workflows and gradually take ownership of a critical part of the patient journey.
Responsibilities

• Own and track the pre-operative process for multiple surgical patients from booking through readiness for surgery.

• Keep each patient's pre-operative checklist current, identifying missing clearances, tests, records, documentation, and other requirements before they become delays.

• Coordinate required appointments and testing, including imaging, medical clearances, laboratory work, and other pre-operative requirements.

• Contact hospitals, imaging centers, laboratories, physicians' offices, and other healthcare facilities to obtain outstanding information and keep cases moving.

• Follow up persistently with outside providers when testing, records, or clearances are delayed, advocating for patients while maintaining professional communication.

• Conduct or support standardized pre-operative patient calls and clearly walk patients through established non-clinical instructions and next steps.

• Maintain accurate documentation of patient conversations, completed requirements, pending items, and case status within the appropriate systems.

• Communicate surgical readiness, outstanding requirements, and potential delays clearly to the broader practice team.

• Recognize clinical questions, unusual circumstances, or concerns that fall outside your administrative scope and escalate them promptly rather than providing independent medical advice.

• Provide additional medical administrative and patient-coordination support when needed to improve the efficiency of the surgical process.

Requirements

Must-Have:

• 3+ years of experience in medical administration, surgical coordination, patient coordination, pre-operative coordination, or closely related healthcare operations.

• Hands-on experience working in a U.S. medical practice or healthcare environment.

• Direct experience coordinating surgical or pre-operative patients, including appointments, tests, medical records, clearances, or required documentation.

• Experience using EMR, CRM, patient-management, or comparable medical-office systems.

• Confidence communicating directly with patients and contacting hospitals, imaging centers, laboratories, physicians' offices, and other healthcare providers.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with strong documentation, organization, case-tracking, and follow-through skills.

• Sound judgment regarding administrative versus clinical responsibilities, including knowing when an issue must be escalated to clinical staff.

Nice to Have:

• Experience in plastic surgery, cosmetic surgery, aesthetics, or another high-touch private-pay medical environment.

• Medical Assistant training, nursing-related education, healthcare education, or equivalent clinical-office experience.

• Experience conducting standardized pre-operative patient calls.

title: Real Estate Deal Analyst & Coordinator
description:
Real Estate Deal Analyst & Coordinator
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (30+ hours/week)
About the Role
At Pavago , one of our clients is hiring a Real Estate Deal Analyst & Coordinator to manage and optimize a high-volume real estate deal pipeline.
This role is ideal for someone with experience in real estate operations, acquisitions, transaction coordination, or deal analysis who enjoys keeping transactions organized from lead through closing. You’ll work closely with buyers, sellers, agents, title companies, and internal teams to evaluate opportunities, coordinate communication, and keep deals moving efficiently.
Responsibilities
Deal Analysis

• Review property information, deal structures, and investment opportunities.

• Analyze financial and operational data to support acquisition decisions.

• Prepare deal summaries and recommendations for leadership.

Pipeline Management

• Track active deals from lead through closing.

• Monitor deadlines, milestones, and follow-ups.

• Identify risks or bottlenecks that could delay transactions.

Communication & Coordination

• Coordinate communication between buyers, sellers, agents, title companies, and internal stakeholders.

• Schedule meetings, calls, and follow-ups.

• Ensure all parties remain aligned throughout the transaction process.

CRM & Documentation

• Maintain accurate CRM records, notes, and deal statuses.

• Prepare reports and supporting documentation.

• Keep deal files organized and up to date.

Process Improvement

• Identify workflow inefficiencies.

• Recommend improvements that increase transaction speed and operational efficiency.

Required Experience & Skills

• Experience in real estate operations, acquisitions, transaction coordination, deal management, or a similar role.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to evaluate property and transaction data.

• Excellent organizational and project management skills.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

• Experience with CRM systems and Google Workspace.

• Ability to manage multiple active deals simultaneously.

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

• Reliable internet connection and availability for 30+ hours per week.

Nice to Have

• Experience in real estate investing, wholesaling, acquisitions, or dispositions.

• Familiarity with U.S. real estate transactions and terminology.

• Experience with Podio, Follow Up Boss, REI BlackBook, or similar platforms.

• Experience supporting high-volume real estate investment teams.

What Success Looks Like

• Deals move through the pipeline efficiently and on schedule.

• CRM records remain accurate and up to date.

• Clear, proactive communication with all stakeholders.

• Leadership has visibility into deal status and next steps.

• Process improvements increase transaction volume and efficiency.

Interview Process

• Initial Recruiter Screening

• Intro Video (Spark Hire)

• Client Interview

• Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply
Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video . It’s a short, self-recorded video that completes your application and allows hiring managers to get to know you before the interview process begins.
Rather than repeating your background during multiple screening calls, you’ll tell your story once, allowing future interviews to focus on meaningful conversations.
Don’t overthink it-you can record as many takes as you’d like before submitting. Your invitation will come from Spark Hire , so please check both your inbox and spam folder.

title: Remote C++ Developer
description:
US Citizens only. This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a SECRET security clearance.

Company Overview

STILMAN Advanced Strategies develops software based on Linguistic Geometry (LG), a unique Artificial Intelligence approach. Our core technology generates predictive, tactically correct Courses of Action (COAs) that dynamically adapt in response to changes in missions and actions taken by the intelligent opposition. These tools support mission planning, rehearsal, training and execution use cases for military commanders across echelons and services. Our applications have been shown to deliver unique value to the warfighter due to the quality of generated COAs, User Experience/User Interface (UX/UI) design that makes it easy to fully comprehend complex COA results and to define mission inputs, as well as ease of deployment and integration with other systems with well-defined modern Application Program Interfaces (APIs).

Our small, distributed team has been developing and continually improving these software applications since 1999. We pride ourselves on the quality of our software, and we are excited as we continue this development with the US Marine Corps, US Navy, US Army, US Missile Defense Agency, and other government organizations to further enhance, integrate, and deploy these products.

The Role

We are looking to bring on one or more additional C++ developers to work on our primary back end applications that include custom Artificial Intelligence engine, military modeling and simulation framework, and integration capabilities for our own front end and third party systems. This system leverages a range of communication protocols, complex data structures and algorithms, GIS & geometric concepts, and high performance optimizations to support a growing range of use cases. You will be expanding our core AI and M&S frameworks to support new domains (from ground forces to ballistic missiles), use cases (from analysis to real-time wargaming), fidelity of modeling of real world environments and entities, and AI-enabled tactics generation. You will also be integrating our software with other M&S systems, military C2 and Intelligence systems, and supporting varied computing environments (from containers in the cloud to embedded computer in a combat vehicle).

You will take part in the design of new features or redesigning existing ones based on customer needs and feedback, implementation of the software changes using C++ with an enduring focus on performance and optimization, model military concepts in software, work closely with front end software developers on APIs, data representation and protocols, as well as work with third party software developers to find user-centric ways to integrate our systems.

Key Experience (REQUIRED)

• C++

• Development for Windows OS

• Performance Optimization

• Data Structures and Algorithms

Key Experience (RECOMMENDED)

• Modeling & Simulation

• GIS & Mapping

• Geometric algorithms

• Mercurial, Git, SVN

• CI/CD, Jenkins

• Docker & Kubernetes

• Linux

• Military concepts and tactics

• Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, and other languages

The Team

We are a small team that's distributed throughout United States and work 100% remote, with some possible travel to customer sites. The software developers are self-motivated and able to work independently, but collaborate closely as a team to leverage individual strengths for the purpose of achieving common objectives. All aspects of our work are collaborative rather than stove piped into narrowly defined roles in order to facilitate transparency, streamlined communications, and shared understanding.

Description des travaux ou des biens livrables :

La conseillère ou le conseiller en gestion de projets de développement accompagne le directeur ou le chef de projet tout au long de la durée du projet dont elle ou il a la responsabilité. La personne occupant ce poste est appuyée par de proches collaborateurs, dont le responsable de produits, l’analyste TI, l’architecte de solutions et le contrôleur de projet (PCO). Elle gère le projet au quotidien. Elle planifie, organise et coordonne les travaux de l’équipe de développement selon la méthode agile de type mêlée (scrum). Elle assure la cohésion des activités afin de respecter les objectifs, les coûts, les échéanciers, la qualité attendue et la portée du projet. Elle assure également l’implantation harmonieuse de la solution, tout en se souciant des risques et des mesures transitoires permettant de livrer le projet à l’organisation. Responsabilités principales

• Actualise l’information concernant le projet et vérifie qu’il répond aux besoins exprimés par le client; • Maintient une communication efficace entre toutes les parties prenantes concernant l’état d’avancement, les problématiques rencontrées et les enjeux associés au projet; • Supervise la mise en place des modalités de la gestion du projet et du développement et s’assure du respect de ces modalités; • Recommande aux instances concernées des orientations ou des solutions aux problèmes éprouvés; • Se conforme aux processus relatifs aux biens livrables du bureau de projets de l'Office ainsi qu'aux processus relatifs à la reddition de comptes telle que définie dans la Loi sur la gouvernance et la gestion des ressources informationnelles (LGGRI); • Peut être appelé à jouer aussi le rôle de maître de mêlée (scrum master); • Avec l’appui du contrôleur de projet (PCO) : a.Veille au respect de la portée, de la qualité, des coûts et de l’échéancier du projet; b.Coordonner les différents processus relatifs à la gestion de projet (processus des demandes de changements, résolution des points en suspens, suivi adéquat des risques, gestion de la qualité des livrables et approbation des livrables en matière de gestion de projet et de contenu); c.Supervise la rédaction des rapports d’avancement et la production des biens livrables relatifs à la gestion du projet; d.Supervise la production des indicateurs de performance du projet et la réalisation du tableau de bord; • Coordonne les liens, s’il y a lieu, entre le projet placé sous sa responsabilité et les autres projets de l’organisation; • Organise le transfert de connaissances vers les équipes concernées par l’entretien de la solution, s’il y a lieu.
Profil

Connaissances générales requises • Excellente connaissance des pratiques de développement agile; • Excellente connaissance des phases de la gestion de projet et de la production des biens livrables associés (démarrage, planification et organisation, exécution, surveillance et contrôle, clôture); • Excellente connaissance des technologies de développement Microsoft en infonuagique. Connaissances spécifiques et habiletés requises

• Posséder au moins dix-huit (18) ans d’expérience dans des projets de développement de nouvelles solutions informatiques, dont dix (10) anscomme chargée de projet ou comme maîtresse ou maître de mêlée (scrum master), dont cinq (5) ans dans un contexte d’agilité (escouades agiles en mêlée [scrum]) s’apparentant à un cadre similaire à celui de l’Office.

• Avoir réalisé au moins trois (3) mandats à titre de chargée ou de chargé de projet dans des organisations de même envergure ou d’une envergure comparable à celle de l’Office.

We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Pricing Analyst , who will be responsible for maximizing spot market win rate and margin across client’s automated and manual pricing channels. This role monitors load boards on behalf of multiple customers, personally bids on exception freight that falls outside the parameters of automated pricing bot, and continuously evaluates bot performance to recommend rule and rate adjustments that improve coverage and competitiveness. The Pricing Analyst partners with carrier sales, operations, and technology teams to ensure pricing decisions are fast, accurate, and aligned with market conditions.
Responsibilities :
Load Board Monitoring & Spot Bidding

• Monitor load boards and bid portals in real time across an assigned portfolio of customers.

• Identify available spot freight opportunities and prioritize by margin potential, service risk, and customer importance.

• Submit competitive, timely bids and rate confirmations directly on loads within pricing authority.

•
Track win/loss outcomes and reasons (rate, timing, capacity, service) to inform pricing strategy.

Exception Freight Pricing

• dentify and price freight that cannot be bid automatically by the pricing bot due to non-standard lanes, equipment, service requirements, or market volatility.

• Apply market knowledge, historical rate data, and carrier capacity insight to price exception loads accurately and quickly.

• Escalate high-risk or high-value exceptions to leadership when pricing authority limits are reached.

•
Document pricing rationale for exception freight to support audit, margin review, and bot rule development.

Bot Optimization & Rule Tuning

•
Continuously evaluate automated bidding bot performance, including win rate, coverage, and margin by

lane and customer.

• Identify patterns in bot losses or missed opportunities and translate them into concrete rule, rate, or parameter change recommendations.

• Partner with technology and pricing leadership to test, validate, and implement bot rule updates.

•
Maintain documentation of bot logic changes and their measured impact on win rate and margin.

Analytics, Reporting & Forecasting

• Analyze spot market trends, lane-level rate movement, and competitive pricing to inform bidding strategy.

• Maintain accurate records of bids, wins, losses, and exception pricing in CRM/pricing systems.

• Deliver regular reporting on win rate, coverage, and margin performance by customer, lane, and channel(bot vs. manual).

• Support forecasting of spot volume and pricing performance for leadership review.

Working conditions :

• Working schedule: Monday - Friday 08:00-17:00 EST

• Remote mode of work

• 10+ business days of paid time off

• Team building and corporate events

• Equipment provided

• A supportive team

Requirements

• 2+ years of experience in freight brokerage pricing, carrier sales, or transportation analytics.

• Working knowledge of load boards (DAT, Truckstop, or similar) and spot market bidding dynamics.

• Comfort making fast, high-volume pricing decisions under time pressure.

• Analytical mindset; able to translate performance data into specific, actionable rule or rate changes.

• Familiarity with automated pricing/bidding tools or a strong aptitude for learning rule-based systems.

• Proficiency in CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint).

title: Machine Learning Scientist/Engineer
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Science Teams

We are looking for a Research Scientist to join the Multi-Embodiment Generalist Agent (MEGA) team within Wayve Science as a founding member. MEGA is building foundation models for general-purpose robots: models that learn from large-scale video, language, and robot-interaction data, then generalize across tasks and embodiments, including mobile manipulators, dual-arm platforms, and humanoids. Our aim is to build agents that can perceive, reason about, and act reliably in the physical world. You will help define and build the foundation-model learning stack for robotics: novel model architectures, pre-training objectives, post-training methods, and scalable data and training systems. The work combines frontier ML research with a direct route to real-world evaluation on a growing fleet of robots. Your work may span vision-language-action models, world and action models, video and multimodal models, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and self-supervised learning. You will work with large-scale video and robotics datasets and distributed training infrastructure to develop increasingly capable, robust, and general robot policies. You will collaborate with research scientists, ML engineers, roboticists, and hardware teams to turn promising ideas into large-scale experiments, strong research contributions, and compelling robot demonstrations.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Design and run experiments on model architectures, learning objectives and data strategies for robot foundation models.

- Build scalable pre-training and post-training methods using web video, egocentric video and robot-interaction data.

- Curate, filter, mix and evaluate large robotics datasets, including egocentric, UMI and teleoperated data.

- Develop and use distributed training pipelines for large multimodal models and datasets.

- Partner with ML engineers, roboticists and hardware teams to turn research progress into measurable real-world robot performance.

- Communicate findings through rigorous internal reviews, publications and robot demonstrations.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Research and develop model architectures, learning objectives, and data strategies for robot foundation models.

- Develop scalable self-supervised and generative pre-training methods using web video, egocentric video, and robot-interaction data.

- Develop post-training approaches, including supervised fine-tuning, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and related methods, to improve real-world robot capabilities.

- Curate, filter, and evaluate large-scale robotics datasets, including egocentric, UMI, and teleoperated data.

- Build and use distributed training pipelines for large models and large multimodal datasets.

- Work closely with robotics and hardware teams to connect model progress to measurable real-world performance.

- Communicate research clearly internally and, where appropriate, through publications and Wayve’s scientific presence.

 

🙌 You should apply if

- Experience in machine learning, with a focus on multimodal foundation models and data for foundation models.

- Experience with scalable training, such as multi-node training, large datasets and/or large model training.

- Strong research track record, including publications in top-tier venues such as ICRA, CoRL, CVPR, NeurIPS, ICML or ICLR.

- Strong engineering skills and hands-on experience with modern machine learning frameworks.

- Ability to design and run rigorous experiments while collaborating closely with engineering and robotics teams.

- Experience translating research ideas into working systems, experiments or deployed capabi

title: Manager, Pricing & Negotiation – Diabetes Care Division (Ontario)
description:
Job Title: Manager, Pricing & Negotiation - Diabetes Care Division (Ontario)
Job Location: Canada - Ontario - Remote
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full time
Job Seniority Level:

About Abbott
Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.
Working at Abbott
At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:

• Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

• A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

• A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity
This position is field-based in Ontario. The ideal candidate will be based in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA). At Abbott, we believe people with diabetes should have the freedom to enjoy active lives. That’s why we’re focused on helping people with diabetes manage their health more effectively and comfortably, with life-changing products that provide accurate data to drive better-informed decisions. We’re revolutionizing the way people monitor their glucose levels with our new sensing technology.
As a member of our Market Access team, you will be accountable for identifying and executing pricing and negotiation strategies for the portfolio of products and play an active role in pCPA and private payer negotiations to execute listing agreements and drive identification of pricing opportunities in various markets.
You provide expertise, leadership and guidance through process improvement, interactive communication and cross-functional collaboration. You build a variety of strategies, support scenario analysis as part of the market access and brand planning process, and provide insights and guidance on emerging trends, challenges and opportunities in the pricing, contracting and related market access areas aligned to our strategic direction.
What You’ll Do

• Provide subject matter expertise to the market access team as well as the local and North America organization on Canadian and provincial pricing regulations and requirements for all diabetes care products

• Applies brand knowledge and pricing expertise to build and implement pricing strategies to maximize commercial contribution for assigned portfolio across the lifecycle including launch, negotiations, loss of exclusivity and divestiture

• Work with market access and stakeholder relations managers to develop financial models supporting proposed pricing strategies & identify opportunities for innovative pricing constructs

• Actively participate in pCPA, provincial and private payer negotiations for diabetes care products to optimize the commercialization of existing or emerging products

• Lead negotiation of product listing agreements and product listings, while balancing speed and value

• Support team to ensure contracts are compliant and aligned with corporate and legal requirements

• Track performance against contractual terms and KPIs

• Collaborate with market access team on the design, negotiation, and implementation of innovative contracting solutions

• Support lifecycle management of agreements, ensuring performance tracking and optimization

• Identify opportunities for novel reimbursement models and strategic collaborations

• Responsible for securing local and NA approval for product portfolio price strategies (list, net) and ensuring public and private payer contract terms and conditions support organizational objectives

• Communicate complex issues and challenges clearly and appropriately to internal and external partners

Required Qualifications

• Bachelo
